intent: Quality over quantity: correct obvious genre/franchise gameplay mismatches, prefer verified game-specific rules, preserve appropriate franchise rules, and never add unverified IDs.

featuredExclusions.title: Jet Set Radio
featuredExclusions.reason: Duplicate regional title for the original Dreamcast Jet Grind Radio (IGDB 1569).

dailyOverrides.dailyChunk: Finish a three-race cup or one timed championship event, then spend one retry improving your best lap or placing.
Complete two focused pinball table runs, aiming to unlock one new bonus area or beat a personal score before stopping.
Complete one dialogue-and-battle quest segment, recruit or train a party member, then save at the next safe checkpoint.
Finish one full board game or a fixed series of minigames, then stop at the match results screen.
Complete one photo expedition, submit your best pictures for evaluation, then revisit one route for a specific missing species.
Play two pinball table runs, target one new Pokémon capture or evolution, then stop after saving your Pokédex progress.
Finish one rescue request or dungeon expedition, return to the base, then reorganize items before ending the session.
Finish one Ranger mission or major capture challenge, then return to a safe point before taking another assignment.
Complete one puzzle league or five timed challenge rounds, then retry one tough board for a higher combo score.
Complete one tournament bracket or a three-battle set, then update your rental or trained team for the next opponent.
Win two trainer card duels, adjust one deck strategy, then save before challenging the next club or opponent.
Complete one kingdom battle and a short team-training round, then prepare the next territory to capture.
Complete one Grand Prix cup or three race courses, then retry the most difficult course for a better finish.
Resolve one investigation clue chain and interview the next set of witnesses, then stop at the following case checkpoint.
Clear one toy Pokémon arena or map block, recruit a few useful fighters, then stop at the hub.
Finish one on-rails shooting scenario chapter, retry a stage for better accuracy if time allows, then stop at stage select.
Clear one first-person action area or boss encounter, then reload supplies and stop at the next save point.
Finish one tactical battle or job-board mission, allocate job points and equipment, then save before the next encounter.

dailyOverrides.pattern: \bspider man\b.*\b(edge of time|shattered dimensions|friend or foe)\b
dailyOverrides.dailyChunk: Clear one self-contained action chapter or boss encounter and upgrade one combat ability before moving to the next level.
Complete one side-scrolling adventure scene by solving its interaction puzzles, then stop at the next story transition.
Clear one platforming level, collect nearby Pac-Dots and fruit, then return to level select after an optional bonus run.
Play three short arcade attempts and aim to clear one higher board or improve your personal best before stopping.
Play two pinball table missions, aim for one artifact or multiball goal, then stop after banking the high score.

dailyOverrides.notPattern: \b(breath of the wild|tears of the kingdom)\b
dailyOverrides.dailyChunk: Finish one dungeon or side-quest objective, uncover a nearby secret or heart piece, and save at the next safe location.
Clear four to six platforming stages or one world, revisit a secret exit if available, then stop at the map screen.
Clear one complete isometric act by collecting its Flickies, then make one focused special-stage attempt before stopping.
Finish one character mission or stage, then retry for a better emblem or rank before switching characters.
Complete one character-swapping adventure stage and its nearby collectible route, then stop at the next hub.
Clear one maze stage by collecting the keys, then make a timed retry before moving to the next zone.
